models.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B
models.why: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team sharded this 26B MoE across 15 off-brand Android TV boxes (~$55 each, 4GB RAM each, two layers per box) and got working inference - the first real hardware floor for the model, though at 0.39 tok/s.

engines.hardware: 15 off-brand Android TV boxes (~$55 each, 4GB RAM each, two of the model's layers per box), distributed inference
